Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

INTEGRAL STEMS FOR PERCUSSIVE DRILLING 



1. Scope— Covers the requirements for integral stems of 19 mm, 22 mm and 25 mm (width across 
flats) hexagon size used for percussive drilling in rock.

2.2 Tip End 



All dimensions In rrdlllmetres. 





16*3 —I 



2.3 Shank and Co//ar— Conforming to IS : 7456-1974 ' Dimensions for rock drill shanks '. 

3. Material 

3.1 The integral stems shall be manufactured from any high quality fatigue and impact resistant steel. 
The material used shall be at the option of the manufacturer who shall provide a specification if so 
requested by the purchaser. 

3.2 The tip shall be manufactured from tungsten carbide conforming to Grade T or XT of IS : 4005-1967 
' Tungsten carbide for mining tools '. 

4. Designation — An integral stem of 22 mm hexagon size, 34 mm bit gauge and 5 600 mm length 
shall be designated as: 

Integral Stem 22x34x5 600 IS: 7913 

5. Hardness — 435 to 545 W on shank 

375 to 460 HV on collar. 

6. Straightness— When body of stems is laid upon a flat surface and rotated, no point on the line of 
contact shall ba more than 2 mm above the suHace for lengths up to one metre and pro rata for lengths 
above one metre. 

7. Packing — The shank end and tip end of the integral siems shall be capped with plaiiic of 
polyethylene caps for protection agamst choking of hole, rusting and damage during transit and/or 
storage. The integral stems shall be packed in accordance with the best trade practice. 

B. Marking — Every integral stem shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name or trade- mark, 

b) Hexagon size of integral stem, 

c) Bit gauge, and 

d) Length of integral stems. 

8.1 iSi Cettification AfsrA/zig — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 
11.2 For the purpose of marking indenting of integral stems is not recommended.
